Container.Name: mandos
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: mandos monitoring local llm ollama llama-swap prometheus loglook ulmo homelab nightly sweep jobs scheduler
Container.Overview:
EXPERIMENTAL, built for my own homelab: it may not be useful to anyone else, and breaking changes between releases are expected.
Mandos runs monitoring jobs on a schedule with a local language model (any OpenAI-compatible server such as llama-swap or Ollama), keeps their results and shows them on a few pages. It watches and reports; it does not change your systems. The image holds only the engine: the jobs themselves (Python, prompts, queries, pages) are a job pack in the Data folder, changed on the Jobs page or through the API, and an edit applies at the next run.
Setup: open the web UI and create the first account. Then Settings: the model server and models, Pushover, and the services your jobs read (Prometheus, LogLook, ulmo, Pi-hole, Home Assistant). Leave Starter Pack on to get a small example job, or send your own pack with the API (Settings, Account, API tokens).
Mandos needs no Docker socket and no host access. Login cookies are Secure: reach it over HTTPS through a reverse proxy, or turn Insecure Cookie on for plain http://UNRAID_IP.
Web interface: http://UNRAID_IP:8080

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web pages and the API. Not needed when a reverse proxy on the same Docker network reaches the container.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database (settings, users, run history, the jobs' records), the job pack in jobs/, and the login key. Keep on persistent storage.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Schedules and the dates jobs write use this zone.

Config.Name: Starter Pack
Config.Description: 1 copies the example job pack into an empty jobs folder on first start. 0 to start with no jobs (send your own pack through the API).

Config.Name: Insecure Cookie
Config.Description: Set to 1 only when you open mandos over plain http on an address other than localhost (for example http://UNRAID_IP:8080). Leave empty behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Proxy Hops
Config.Description: Reverse proxies in front of mandos; the login's wrong-password limit reads the client address from X-Forwarded-For. 0 when nothing sits in front.

Config.Name: Disable Login
Config.Description: Set to 1 to run without a login screen (only behind your own gate). Also turns off editing the job pack.
